druckenmiller.name: Duquesne Family Office LLC
druckenmiller.weight_rationale: Reportedly ~30% annualized average with no losing year across decades at Duquesne/Soros. Caveat: 13F only captures the long US equity sleeve, not the macro book (FX, rates, commodities) that defines his actual strategy.

soros.name: Soros Fund Management LLC
soros.weight_rationale: Quantum Fund compounded at legendary rates (~30%+ annualized) for decades. Now run more as a family office; same caveat as Druckenmiller — 13F is a fraction of the real book.

buffett.name: Berkshire Hathaway Inc
buffett.weight_rationale: ~19-20% annualized since 1965, the longest and most consistent public track record of any investor tracked here.

appaloosa.name: Appaloosa LP
appaloosa.weight_rationale: One of the best absolute records in hedge fund history — reportedly 25-30%+ annualized net since inception, built on distressed debt and opportunistic equity bets.

baupost.name: Baupost Group LLC
baupost.weight_rationale: ~20% annualized since 1983 with a strong risk-management/capital-preservation reputation.

pershing_square.name: Pershing Square Capital Management LP
pershing_square.weight_rationale: Strong long-run record (~high-teens annualized since 2004) despite a severe 2015-2018 drawdown; concentrated, high-conviction activist bets.

bridgewater.name: Bridgewater Associates LP
bridgewater.weight_rationale: Flagship Pure Alpha fund's long-run return (~11-12% annualized) is solid but unspectacular relative to peers here. Caveat: the 13F equity sleeve is a tiny, non-representative slice of the world's largest macro fund.

renaissance.name: Renaissance Technologies LLC
renaissance.weight_rationale: IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the legendary ~66% gross/39% net annualized record belongs to Medallion, which is closed to outside investors and files no 13F. The 13F comes from RIEF/RIDA, Renaissance's external funds, which have had far more modest and uneven returns. Weighted down to reflect that the public 13F does not represent Renaissance's famous track record.

greenlight.name: Greenlight Capital Inc
greenlight.weight_rationale: Strong first decade (~20%+ annualized in the 2000s) but roughly flat-to-weak from 2015-2020 dragged the long-run blended record down to middling.

scion.name: Scion Asset Management LLC
scion.weight_rationale: Famous for the 2007-08 subprime short ("The Big Short"), but limited consistent public track record since; runs a small, highly concentrated, and volatile public 13F book.
